title: chat-threads/1.0/thread-create
description: Turns a reply chain into a thread: names its root, lists the chain's messages that belong to it, and optionally names it. Sent by someone who wrote in the chain to everyone in the conversation.

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender; the same id goes to every member of a group.

from.description: Sender DID. Always present: these messages are sent authenticated, and the envelope, not the body, says who sent them.

pthid.description: In a group conversation, the group's id. Absent in a pair.

thid.description: The thread's id: the root message's id, equal to body.root.id. Compared case-insensitively.

created_time.description: UTC epoch seconds. Of two creations with the same root, the earlier stands.

expires_time.description: UTC epoch seconds; the root's expiry, when it has one (disappearing-messages/1.0).

id.description: The id of the message referred to. Compared case-insensitively.

author.description: The DID that sent it, as the referring party knows it (its current DID or one it rotated away from).

snippet.description: The start of the referred message's text as it read when the reference was made, or its label (e.g. "Photo") if it has no text. Counted in characters.

root.description: The message at the root of the chain, in the same conversation. Its id is the thread's id.

id.description: The id of the message referred to. Compared case-insensitively.

author.description: The DID that sent it, as the referring party knows it (its current DID or one it rotated away from).

snippet.description: The start of the referred message's text as it read when the reference was made, or its label if it has no text. Counted in characters.

messages.description: The chain's messages that belong to the thread, other than the root, oldest first. May be empty.

name.description: The thread's name, plain text. Absent: the root's label.
